conversationalSummary.text: TODAY is probably one to skip — even though Meio da Baia could be the least-bad attempt, the wind angle looks pretty off and gusts could make it messy, with the waves likely feeling a bit too soft without more push. I’d check Surfline and MEO Beachcam first (preferably before leaving), but unless they look noticeably cleaner than expected, save the drive.

best.explanation: Meio da Baia looks like a fun-sized window for Worth checking, Low confidence: 0.6-1.1 m, 72 kJ, 8 s period, consistent 76/100, and wind is the main risk.  An inconsistent Baía spot that can work well when north-northwest swell reaches the bay; this is best for bodyboard sessions when the bay is clean, there is enough period and size, and the forecast shows a defined wave; 6-9s at mid tide can make exposed beaches like Belgas / Almagreira / Cerro / Meio da Baia sharp and rippable.  Watch: wind angle is poor for this spot; Meio da Baia may feel too soft without more push; gusts over 35 km/h could make it messy.
best.shortExplanation: Meio da Baia is worth a quick check for after work (16:30 start), but it is not a guaranteed session.  Treat it as a check-first call rather than a sure thing.  Wind is the main thing to watch.  The tide and timing are lining up well for this spot.
